description: Apply a mechanical fix for an open issue (1.6+). Default is dry-run; pass confirm:true to write. Every applied change records a rollback id usable via action:'rollback'. Mechanical templates only — semantic rewrites and codemods stay agent-driven.

action.description: Default "apply". Pass "rollback" with `rollback_id` to reverse a previous apply.

confirm.description: "apply" only — when true, write to disk. When false (default), return the would-change list without writing (dry-run).

issue_id.description: "apply" only — the issue id to fix (from projscan_doctor / projscan_analyze). Required for action:"apply".

rollback_id.description: "rollback" only — the id from a prior apply's ApplyResult.

name: projscan_apply_fix
